units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) whether there are motions or applications for recusal;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) whether there are grounds for participation in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) whether a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or concerning an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, is in the territory of the Russian Federation, and, if it is established that the person is outside the Russian Federation, whether it was possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 29.1

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.label: Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.label: Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 1. A judge, member of a collegial body or official to whom an administrative offence case has been referred for consideration may not consider the case if that person:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 1) is a relative of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the victim, a legal representative of an individual or legal entity, defence counsel or a representative;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 2) has a personal, direct or indirect interest in the outcome of the case.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 2. The existence of information about an extra-procedural communication received by a judge concerning an administrative offence case being handled by that judge may not in itself be regarded as grounds for the judge’s recusal.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.2

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.label: Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.label: Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 1. Where the circumstances provided for by part 1 of Article 29.2 of this Code exist, the judge, member of a collegial body or official shall declare self-recusal. The declaration of self-recusal shall be submitted to the president of the relevant court, the head of the collegial body or the superior official.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 2. Where the circumstances provided for by part 1 of Article 29.2 of this Code exist, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the victim, a legal representative of an individual or legal entity, defence counsel, a representative or the prosecutor may apply for recusal of the judge, member of the collegial body or official.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 3. An application for recusal shall be considered by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
units.text: 4. Following consideration of a declaration of self-recusal or an application for recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official considering an administrative offence case, a procedural order granting or refusing the declaration or application shall be issued. If an application for recusal is refused, a repeat application for recusal by the same person on the same grounds shall not be permitted.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.3

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. In preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case, the following questions shall be resolved and, where necessary, a procedural order shall be issued on them:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) setting the time and place for consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) summoning the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.10 of this Code, requesting necessary additional case materials, and ordering an expert examination;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) adjourning consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) returning the administrative offence record and other case materials to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, where the record was drawn up and other case materials prepared by unauthorised persons, the record was incorrectly drawn up and other case materials improperly prepared, or the submitted materials are incomplete and that incompleteness cannot be remedied during consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) forwarding the administrative offence record and other case materials for consideration by the competent authority, if consideration of the case does not fall within the competence of the judge, body or official to whom the administrative offence record and other case materials were submitted for consideration, or if a procedural order recusing the judge, the membership of the collegial body or the official has been issued;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) attaching property, refusing attachment of property or lifting an attachment imposed on property, in accordance with Article 27.20 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) participation of the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.10 of this Code in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system in the cases provided for by Articles 29.14 - 29.16 of this Code;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) appointing defence counsel for a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or concerning an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, if, at the time the relevant administrative offence case is considered, that person is outside the Russian Federation and it is not possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) returning the materials of an administrative offence case to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code, where that case concerns another person and/or another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or where, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against another person or in respect of another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. The procedural orders specified in points 3 and 7 of part 1 of this Article may also be issued during consideration of an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Where the circumstances provided for by Article 24.5 of this Code exist, a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be issued.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Where consideration of an administrative offence case has been adjourned because the persons specified in part 1 of Article 27.15 of this Code failed to appear without a valid reason, and their absence prevents a comprehensive, full, objective and timely ascertainment of the circumstances of the case and its resolution in accordance with the law, the judge, body or official considering the case shall issue a procedural order for compulsory appearance of those persons.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. A copy of the procedural order specified in point 4 of part 1 of this Article, together with the case materials, shall be sent on the day that procedural order is issued to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and also the victim and prosecutor if participating.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.4

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An administrative offence case shall be considered at the place where the offence was committed. Upon a motion by the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the case may be considered at that person’s place of residence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. In cases provided for by an international treaty, an administrative offence case shall be considered at the place where the administrative offence was detected if it was committed in the territory of another state, except in the cases provided for by part 1.3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 19.3, 20.2 and 20.2.2 and part 1 of Article 20.25 (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code shall be considered at the place where the administrative offence was detected.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.3. Cases concerning administrative offences committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Articles 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 15.27.3, 17.13, 19.28 and 19.34, parts 3, 4 and 5 of Article 20.1, and Articles 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 and 20.33 of this Code, and concerning administrative offences consisting in failure to pay administrative fines imposed for commission of administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 and 19.34, parts 3, 4 and 5 of Article 20.1, and Articles 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 and 20.33 of this Code within the period provided for by this Code, shall be considered at the location of the bodies that initiated those cases.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. An administrative offence case in which an administrative investigation was conducted shall be considered at the location of the body that conducted the administrative investigation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences committed by minors, and administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.35, 6.10 and 20.22 of this Code, shall be considered at the place of residence of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 175-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. A case concerning an administrative offence provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 or Chapter 12 of this Code, or an administrative offence in territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property and recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, and also a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system, shall be considered at the location of the body that received the materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, or the monitoring information system.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. A case concerning an administrative offence committed in Antarctica shall be considered at the place of residence of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29.5

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An administrative offence case shall be considered within fifteen days from the day the body or official competent to consider the case receives the administrative offence record and other case materials, or materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, or the monitoring information system.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. An administrative offence case shall be considered within two months from the day the judge competent to consider the case receives the administrative offence record and other case materials.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Where motions are received from participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case or further clarification of the circumstances of the case is necessary, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the judge, body or official considering the case, but by no more than one month. Where a motion is received from the person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the official considering it by no more than two months. Where a motion is received from the person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by part 15 or 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the judge considering it by no more than three months. The judge, body or official considering the case shall issue a reasoned procedural order extending that period.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code shall be considered within five days from the day the judge receives the administrative offence record and other case materials. Extension of that period shall not be permitted.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. A case concerning an administrative offence entailing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be considered on the day the administrative offence record and other case materials are received, and, in relation to a person subjected to administrative detention, no later than 48 hours from the moment of detention, except for consideration of a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.48, part 9 of Article 19.34, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the period provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for commission of an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, initiated against a person who is outside the Russian Federation at the time the administrative offence case is considered.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. A case concerning an administrative offence for which an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity may be imposed and a temporary prohibition of activity has been applied shall be considered no later than seven days from the actual cessation of the activities of branches, representative offices or structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, and of the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of certain types of activity (work), or the provision of services. The period of temporary prohibition of activity shall be credited towards the period of administrative suspension of activity.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. Repealed. — Federal Law of 21.07.2014 No. 210-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.15.2 and 14.15.3 of this Code shall be considered within ten days from the day the judge receives the administrative offence record and other case materials. Extension of that period shall not be permitted.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 29.6

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. When an administrative offence case is considered:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) it shall be announced who is considering the case, which case is to be considered, and who is being held administratively liable and under which law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the attendance of the individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted shall be established, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, as shall the attendance of other persons participating in consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) the powers of the legal representatives of the individual or legal entity, defence counsel and the representative shall be verified;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) it shall be ascertained whether participants in the proceedings have been duly notified, the reasons for participants’ failure to appear shall be established, and a decision shall be made to consider the case in their absence or to adjourn its consideration;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) persons participating in consideration of the case shall have their rights and duties explained to them;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) submitted applications for recusal and motions shall be considered;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) a procedural order adjourning consideration of the case shall be issued where:
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: а) a declaration of self-recusal or an application for recusal of the judge, member of the collegial body or official considering the case is received, if their recusal prevents consideration of the case on the merits;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7
